svg.title: Ontology-grounded, tool-verified agent versus plain LLM: planned architecture
svg.desc: The main comparison tests accuracy, faithfulness and safety in workload scheduling. Four additional scheduling references share visible inputs and an execution gate; private data and offline references stay outside policy inputs. F02 schemas, D01/D02 tooling, D06 structural source/window checks, D03 provisional fixtures, S01 transitions, controlled K02 RDF/SPARQL retrieval with F02 flat Context, P01 arithmetic pending S02 adoption, L01 empty-queue handling, independent E01 replay and E04 draft synthetic review preparation and A01/A03 core are implemented; scientific acceptance and the full scheduling pipeline remain pending.

g.text: Does an ontology-grounded, tool-verified agent improve the accuracy, faithfulness and safety
of data-center sustainability recommendations compared with a plain LLM?

g.text: Main comparison: agent versus plain_llm. Four additional policies provide scheduling references.

g.text: Simulator exposes arrived jobs and occupancy; one authoritative constraint snapshot feeds all systems.
RDF + SHACL + controlled SPARQL provide typed facts and IDs; flat context carries equivalent information.
Nisha's common runner asks policies for proposals; policies cannot mutate the simulator.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203449

g.text: At most one repair → verify again

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203449

g.text: Unsafe starts can still be blocked

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203449

g.text: All use the same visible inputs

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203449

g.text: Production checker → latest-state gate → controller-only execute_step → simulator advances once per slot.
Check IDs, capacity, deadlines, evidence, plan hash and state version; execute eligible current starts only.
Rejection starts no new jobs; running work continues. Future plan entries remain intentions.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203449

g.text: Record original, repaired, fallback and final outputs;
record gate verdict and actually executed actions.
Keep source IDs, calculations, units, assumptions,
call counts, costs and failures for audit/scoring.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203449

g.text: completed work, missed deadlines and cost.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203449

g.text: OFFLINE ONLY — no policy access to private data or oracle answers
Certified visible-state MILP labels train C/D on development data; inference never calls the solver.
Private realized carbon and full-episode hindsight bounds support scoring after decisions.
Freeze before held-out runs. Independent blinded Matty/Nisha annotation remains required.
24 decision + 6 completion slots; no completion-slot model calls. Q01–Q13 stay open where unresolved.
Implemented: F02; D01-D03/D06; S01; K02; P01; L01 no-op; E01/E04; A01/A03 core. Integration pending.
